comments.body:
_⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🟡 Minor_

**Handle undefined `wsToken` to avoid `"undefined"` string in URL.**

If `CHANNEL_OPTIONS` is undefined or lacks `wsToken`, the URL becomes `/storybook-server-channel?token=undefined` (literal string), which will fail server validation. Consider conditionally appending the token parameter.



<details>
<summary>🛡️ Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
     const { wsToken } = CHANNEL_OPTIONS || {};
-    const channelUrl = `${protocol}://${hostname}:${port}/storybook-server-channel?token=${wsToken}`;
+    const channelUrl = `${protocol}://${hostname}:${port}/storybook-server-channel${wsToken ? `?token=${wsToken}` : ''}`;
```

</details>

<!-- suggestion_start -->

<details>
<summary>📝 Committable suggestion</summary>

> ‼️ **IMPORTANT**
> Carefully review the code before committing. Ensure that it accurately replaces the highlighted code, contains no missing lines, and has no issues with indentation. Thoroughly test & benchmark the code to ensure it meets the requirements.

```suggestion
    const { wsToken } = CHANNEL_OPTIONS || {};
    const channelUrl = `${protocol}://${hostname}:${port}/storybook-server-channel${wsToken ? `?token=${wsToken}` : ''}`;
```

</details>

<!-- suggestion_end -->

<details>
<summary>🤖 Prompt for AI Agents</summary>

```
Verify each finding against the current code and only fix it if needed.

In `@code/core/src/channels/index.ts` around lines 38 - 39, CHANNEL_OPTIONS may be
undefined or lack wsToken so channelUrl currently can include the literal
"undefined" token; change the construction of channelUrl (the code around
CHANNEL_OPTIONS, wsToken, protocol, hostname, port) to only append the
"?token=..." query parameter when wsToken is a defined non-empty value (use
optional chaining or a guard on CHANNEL_OPTIONS.wsToken and build the
querystring conditionally), ensuring no "?token=undefined" is produced and
leaving the token parameter out entirely when absent.
```

</details>
